rows.my_view: Undervalued at ~16x; the ~23% YTD drop to $61.25 against $95-104 targets is a China discount to arbitrage.
rows.committee: The 2.4x P/E is a currency illusion; the honest number is ~16x trailing / ~12x forward, which is fair-to-cheap and 'cheap' only if the discount closes.

rows.my_view: A reinforcing cash engine where AI strengthens the core.
rows.committee: Growth has settled at ~7-8%, largely a recovery off the 2022 regulatory trough rather than a new accelerating trend.

rows.my_view: Margins are expanding and the cash engine is strong.
rows.committee: Gross margin hit a record 58%, but operating margin at 33% is still 15 points below its FY2021 peak of 48% — opex is where AI spend hides.

rows.my_view: A very wide moat built on WeChat and a diverse cash engine.
rows.committee: Agreed — WeChat's billion-user network and switching costs are one of the world's widest consumer moats, with ByteDance contesting only the ad growth edge.

rows.my_view: Funds AI and returns capital without dilution.
rows.committee: The buyback runs only ~1%/yr against RMB 466B idle cash and doubling capex, so 'returns capital' is thinner than claimed and may itself drive the discount.

rows.my_view: The China discount may be a permanent feature, not an opportunity (self-flagged).
rows.committee: Agreed — the structural China/ADR discount is the dominant, unmonitorable risk, and the company can compound while the stock goes nowhere for years.
The ~16x P/E anchor is unreliable because GAAP earnings carry investment-portfolio noise — FY2023 net income fell 39% while revenue rose 10% — a distortion the thesis never priced.

rows.my_view: Multiple normalization if the discount closes.
rows.committee: Watch the ADR discount to the Hong Kong 0700.HK line — if it persists or widens through two quarters of rising earnings, the discount was structural, not an opportunity.

confidence.label: Moderate
confidence.why: The business quality is well-evidenced and the dominant risk is clearly identified, but the entire payoff hinges on an unmonitorable China/ADR discount and on GAAP earnings polluted by portfolio noise.

final_verdict: Correctly opened as a monitored satellite — a wide-moat cash machine bought at a fair, not cheap, price where the return hinges on a discount the owner himself flagged as his weakest leg.
